segments.he:
תּוֹרָה עז
הַכְּלָל הוּא, כָּל מַה שֶּׁאָנוּ עוֹשִׂים הֵן הַתְּפִלָּה וְהֵן לִמּוּד, הוּא כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה מַלְכוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ:
segments.en: The primary peace is to join two opposites. Therefore — do not let your thoughts alarm you if you see a person who is the complete opposite of your view — and it appears to you that it is impossible in any way to maintain peace with him. And likewise when you see two people who are two complete opposites — do not say that it is impossible to make peace between them. On the contrary — this is the primary completeness of peace: to strive for peace between two opposites — as Hashem Yisborach makes peace in His heights between fire and water — which are two opposites.
